name: scry
description: 本地桌面 app：通过原生 Provider adapter 驱动 AI coding agent，把执行过程实时画成 trace 树（可观测/可控制/可恢复）
author: bingjiang0611

scripts.build:cli: tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json && rm -rf packages/turn-recorder-cli/dist && tsc -p tsconfig.recorder.json && chmod +x packages/turn-recorder-cli/dist/cli/scry.js
scripts.check:cli-release: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/cli src/core/turn-recorder src/shared/turn-record.test.ts src/shared/credit-usage.test.ts src/shared/trace.test.ts src/shared/runtime.test.ts src/main/normalize.test.ts src/main/danger.test.ts src/main/claude-locate.test.ts src/main/managed-turn-commit.test.ts && npm run build:cli && npm run smoke:cli-package
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test:regressions: vitest run src/renderer/session-archive-effects.test.ts src/main/app-store.test.ts src/renderer/skill-load-evidence.test.ts src/renderer/session-capability-contract.test.tsx src/renderer/session-capability-calls.test.ts src/renderer/components/PinnedSummary.test.tsx src/renderer/components/render.test.tsx src/renderer/dock-badge-permission.test.ts src/main/context-admission.test.ts src/main/trace-turn-progress.test.ts src/main/trace-turn-progress.regression.test.ts src/main/commit-hook-trust.test.ts src/main/commit-hook-trust.regression.test.ts src/main/managed-turn-notifications.test.ts && npm run test:renderer:ui
scripts.test:renderer:ui: node scripts/session-capability-ui-smoke.mjs && node scripts/analytics-credits-ui-smoke.mjs && node scripts/chat-preview-ui-smoke.mjs && node scripts/session-performance-ui-smoke.mjs && npm run test:background-ui && npm run test:steer-ui && node scripts/desktop-remote-ui-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:desktop-remote: npm run build && npm run build:cli && node scripts/desktop-remote-host-smoke.mjs --dev && node scripts/desktop-remote-ui-smoke.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:shell
scripts.pack: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run pack:artifact
scripts.pack:artifact: npm run build && npm run build:cli && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs && npm run check:packaged-app && npm run smoke:electron
scripts.smoke:electron: node scripts/external-links-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-security-smoke.mjs && node scripts/electron-security-smoke.mjs --files-only && node scripts/desktop-remote-host-smoke.mjs
